Explanation: Lets your program use the List control. This is not the same List as the one in Libraries.Containers.
Adds a list to a page. The name is what a screen reader calls the list.
Finds a list on a page by its name.
Adds a line of text to the end of the list.
Adds a line of text at a position. Position 0 is the top.
Removes the first item with that text and returns it.
Returns the text of the item at a position.
Returns how many items are in the list.
Moves the selection to the item at a position.
Sets the behavior that runs when any item is activated.
Returns the text of a ListItem.
